# XREC Canonical Vectors

This corpus is the XREC-01 reference profile for R-1..R-10 reduction. Fixture files describe native observed-state shapes; `*.canonical.json` files pin exact restricted-JSON bytes. Later XREC cards add digest, tree, witness, and verifier vectors without changing these record bytes.
